capabilities: fold and unfold code blocks with a click on a chevron
show language, first line, and a copy button on folded blocks
persist fold state as a {fold} marker on the opening fence
run commands to fold or unfold all blocks or the block at the cursor
extras: The manifest description carries an unreviewed-plugin notice from Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's editor offers no way to collapse long code blocks, so lengthy snippets take up space and clutter notes.
summary: Editor plugin that folds code blocks into a single preview line with a click, keeping long snippets out of the way until needed.
